gtia.assembly_yard.ui.idle.no_recipe: Waiting: no assembly recipe matches the buses
gtia.assembly_yard.ui.idle.power: Waiting: not enough EU in the Nexus network
gtia.assembly_yard.ui.manual.1: Every phase built opens eighteen slipways, ninety at the fifth. Each open slipway assembles sixteen at a time.
gtia.assembly_yard.ui.manual.11: =megastructure controllers: EU x0.5 here (the yard is built for them)
gtia.assembly_yard.ui.manual.2: =parallel = 16 x open slipways;  slipways = 18 x phases
gtia.assembly_yard.ui.manual.3: Recipes: the Assembly Line and the Assembler, EU from the Nexus network. Closed slipways cost nothing.
gtia.assembly_yard.ui.manual.5: The fabrication lasers are fed by the star's light: the power they get grows with its luminosity.
gtia.assembly_yard.ui.manual.6: =build rate = 1 + log10(L / L☉), from x0.5 to x4
gtia.assembly_yard.ui.manual.7: The Sun gives x1; a 15 M☉ blue giant (L ~ 10^4.6 L☉) reaches the ceiling. Make one with the System Creator.
gtia.assembly_yard.ui.manual.9: Crews on every shift double the build rate, but the lasers run hot and waste power.
gtia.assembly_yard.ui.manual.tip: How the yard works, with its formulas.
gtia.birch_world.ui.frozen: Paradox: the loops reopen in %s s
gtia.birch_world.ui.idle.no_recipe: Waiting: no hosted recipe matches the buses
gtia.birch_world.ui.manual.1: A spinning black hole's interior allows closed timelike curves: work sent round one is done before it is paid for.
gtia.birch_world.ui.manual.10: The loops then close for 60 s. Feed the hole (HRAE-MC) to raise the credit.
gtia.birch_world.ui.manual.11: The Causal era grows with debt paid back: I at 2^50 EU, II at 2^55, III at 2^60.
gtia.birch_world.ui.manual.2: =speed = x64;  parallel = 256 x modules;  room = 80 modules x phases
gtia.birch_world.ui.manual.3: Modules are multiblock controllers in the input buses, as in the Suprashell. Their EU is not drawn: it is owed.
gtia.birch_world.ui.manual.5: The loop's tension makes the debt grow; pay it back at the rate on the dial, from the Nexus network.
gtia.birch_world.ui.manual.6: =debt x 1.0005 each second;  repayment = 2^40 EU/s x dial (0-16)
gtia.birch_world.ui.manual.7: =credit = 2^44 EU x layers x M/M☉  (40 layers a phase)
gtia.birch_world.ui.manual.9: History stays consistent (Novikov): a debt past the credit cannot stand. The debt vanishes, with all in the output buses.
gtia.birch_world.ui.manual.tip: How the time loops work, with the formulas.
gtia.birch_world.ui.repay.tip: Repayment: left click +2^40 EU/s, right click -2^40 EU/s.
gtia.crafting_station.empty: Place chests or other containers on the sides or below the station to craft from them.
gtia.disintegrator.ui.manual.1: What holds a body together is its gravitational binding energy: for a uniform sphere U = 3GM^2 / 5R.
gtia.disintegrator.ui.manual.10: The last 10% is the star: a million mB of gas per % per solar mass, three parts hydrogen to one helium.
gtia.disintegrator.ui.manual.11: Taking the star erases the system; its terrain is wiped at the next server start, unless a new star is made there first.
gtia.disintegrator.ui.manual.2: =U = 2^52 EU x (M/M☉)^2;  paid from the Nexus network at 2^36 EU/t x phases
gtia.disintegrator.ui.manual.3: Peeling from the outside in, taking a share f of the mass costs the share e of the binding energy:
gtia.disintegrator.ui.manual.6: Crust (to 25%): silicon, aluminium, calcium. Mantle (to 60%): magnesium, iron, silicon.
gtia.disintegrator.ui.manual.7: Core (to 90%): iron, nickel, cobalt, platinum, palladium, gold, osmium, iridium, uranium.
gtia.disintegrator.ui.manual.8: =dust of each = 4096 x % taken x M/M☉ x metallicity
gtia.disintegrator.ui.manual.tip: How the system comes apart, with its formulas.
gtia.disintegrator.ui.no_target: No target: pick one of your made systems
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.collapse.tip: The core falls in with no rebound: 60% of the star becomes a black hole, a burst of research.
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.event.2: The core fell into a black hole
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.event.3: Helium flash: the suppressor rings took it
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.manual.1: The suppressor rings damp the core's fusion. Less fusion means fewer neutrinos and less pressure: the core contracts and heats (virial theorem).
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.manual.10: Supernova: the core rebounds and the shock spreads r-process elements (gold, platinum, osmium, iridium, uranium, thorium, europium); a neutron star of 1.4 M☉ is left.
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.manual.11: =dust of each = 64 × M × Z  (a tenth without the containment rings, phase 5)
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.manual.12: Black hole: the core falls in without a rebound; 60% of the star stays as a black hole for the Kugelblitz, the HRAE-MC and the Suprashell.
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.manual.13: Either ending gives a burst of research (2000 or 5000 points). Do it in a system made for it: the star does not come back.
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.manual.14: Repair: idle, put suppressor-ring blocks in an input bus (+5% each).
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.manual.4: Research goes to the owner's GTNA knowledge points, area gtia:astrophysics.
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.manual.7: At a full deficit a star of 8 M☉ or more (the core-collapse limit) is ready to end; the probes (phase 4) must be built.
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.manual.8: A lighter star only flares: a helium flash takes 25% of the suppressor rings and half the deficit.
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.manual.tip: How the suppressor works, with its formulas.
gtia.fusion_suppressor.ui.supernova.tip: The core collapses and rebounds: r-process dust (a tenth without the containment rings), a neutron star is left.
gtia.hraemc.needs_hole: No black hole here: the HRAE-MC needs a system whose centre is one.
gtia.hraemc.ui.manual.1: Matter fed to the disk spirals down to the innermost stable orbit and gives off part of its rest energy as light.
gtia.hraemc.ui.manual.11: The polar collars (phase 4) catch the Blandford–Znajek jets, which carry a share a² of the accretion power.
gtia.hraemc.ui.manual.13: The antennas (phase 5) give log₂(power)/4 research points a second (GTNA knowledge, area gtia:astrophysics).
gtia.hraemc.ui.manual.14: Everything swallowed adds to the hole's mass, and with it to the Eddington limit.
gtia.hraemc.ui.manual.3: =power = units × 2^32 EU × η, at most the Eddington limit 2^40 EU/t × M/M☉
gtia.hraemc.ui.manual.4: One unit is an item or 1000 mB of any fluid. Feeding spins the hole up (the disk's matter carries its turn in).
gtia.hraemc.ui.manual.6: Inside the ergosphere nothing can stand still. Matter split there leaves with more energy than it brought: the extra comes from the hole's spin.
gtia.hraemc.ui.manual.7: =rotational share = 1 - √((1 + √(1 - a²)) / 2), up to 29% of the mass
gtia.hraemc.ui.manual.9: It slows the hole down; a slower hole lowers η. Balance the feed and the share.
gtia.hraemc.ui.manual.tip: How the plant works, with its formulas.
gtia.hraemc.ui.penrose.tip: Share of the Penrose ring's draw: left click +10%, right click -10%. It takes the spin.
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.breached: Containment breached: repair the chamber with its blocks
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.1: Pour enough energy into a small enough volume and it falls in on itself: a kugelblitz. Its mass is the energy that made it.
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.10: Below the critical mass (10 000 kg; 1000 kg with the stabilisers of phase 3) it runs away and flashes out: all it held is gone and the chamber breaks.
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.11: The charge stops at the target mass. A target near the critical mass makes a strong generator that must be fed all the time.
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.13: From phase 4 the funnels take any item and fluid from the hatches as mass: a gram each item and each 1000 mB (the chamber's own blocks are kept for repairs).
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.14: What falls in never comes back as itself: only as Hawking light.
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.2: =M = E / c²;  in play 1 kg = 2^40 EU
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.3: It forms once the light holds 10^5 kg: lighter, it would evaporate faster than any laser feeds it. The lasers pour up to 2^40 EU/t, 2^48 with the battery of phase 2.
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.6: =in play: P = 2^30 EU/t at 10^6 kg, × 100 for each tenth of the mass
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.7: A small hole is hot and bright and lasts little; a big one is cold, dim and almost forever.
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.8: The outer blades (phase 5) catch 90% of it as EU for the Nexus network; before them it is lost as heat.
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.manual.tip: How the silo works, with Hawking's formulas.
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.rate.tip: Charge rate of the lasers: left click up, right click down (phase 1 up to 2^40 EU/t).
gtia.kugelblitz.ui.target.tip: Mass the charge stops at: left click up, right click down.
gtia.machine.assembly_yard.tooltip.0: A shipyard ring round the star of its system, built in five phases: up to ninety slipways.
gtia.machine.assembly_yard.tooltip.1: Runs Assembly Line and Assembler recipes: 16 parallels per open slipway.
gtia.machine.assembly_yard.tooltip.2: The fabrication lasers run on starlight: brighter stars build faster. Rush shifts: x2 speed, x2.5 EU.
gtia.machine.birch_world.tooltip.0: Shells round a black hole whose time loops make almost anything, built in five phases: the Causal era.
gtia.machine.birch_world.tooltip.1: Hosts multiblock controllers like the Suprashell; recipes run 64 times as fast and their EU becomes causal debt.
gtia.machine.birch_world.tooltip.2: Pay it back from the Nexus network; past the credit, a paradox erases the debt and what it bought.
gtia.machine.disintegrator.tooltip.0: Takes a made star system of yours apart, layer by layer, paying its binding energy; built in five phases.
gtia.machine.disintegrator.tooltip.1: Crust, mantle and core give their metals; the star gives hydrogen and helium, and the system is gone.
gtia.machine.disintegrator.tooltip.2: Pick where to stop: before the star the system stays.
gtia.machine.entangled_miner.tooltip.0: Mines the bedrock vein on the Vein Card in its input slot, forever. Each operation takes 1, 2 or 4 raw ores by the vein's purity.
gtia.machine.entangled_miner.tooltip.1: At most %s miners per vein; the next ones wait for a free slot.
gtia.machine.entangled_miner.tooltip.sam: Only veins in its own dimension (any dimension from EV).
gtia.machine.fusion_suppressor.tooltip.0: Damps the fusion of the star of its system and reads its neutrinos for research, built in five phases.
gtia.machine.fusion_suppressor.tooltip.1: A star of 8 M☉ or more, held until its core gives way, ends as you choose: a supernova (r-process dust) or a black hole.
gtia.machine.fusion_suppressor.tooltip.2: Lighter stars only flare: a helium flash hits the suppressor rings.
gtia.machine.hraemc.tooltip.0: A power plant around the black hole of its system, built in five phases: only where the star collapsed or was made as one.
gtia.machine.hraemc.tooltip.1: Accretion (efficiency by the hole's spin, capped by Eddington), the Penrose process (takes the spin) and the polar jets.
gtia.machine.hraemc.tooltip.2: Feeding spins the hole up, Penrose slows it: keep them in balance. EU to the Nexus network, research with the antennas.
gtia.machine.industrial_apiary.tooltip.b: No bees fly around: the species comes from the cage, frames and flowers are recipe inputs.
gtia.machine.industrial_apiary.tooltip.p: Keeps a caged bee as an item and produces its combs.
gtia.machine.kugelblitz.tooltip.0: A black hole made of light, held between two claws, built in five phases; works in any star system.
gtia.machine.kugelblitz.tooltip.1: Lasers and the vault give it mass (E = mc²); it gives energy back as Hawking radiation (P ∝ 1/M²).
gtia.machine.kugelblitz.tooltip.2: A small hole is a strong generator but close to running away: below the critical mass it flashes out.
gtia.machine.matrioshka_brain.tooltip.0: Shells of computers around the star of the Nexus System, built in five phases. Works only there.
gtia.machine.matrioshka_brain.tooltip.1: Each phase adds a shell: 2^(21+n) CWU/t at 300 K, more on cold outer shells (Landauer's limit).
gtia.machine.matrioshka_brain.tooltip.2: Sends CWU through Optical Data Transmission Hatches; CWU nobody asks for becomes Ψ.
gtia.machine.mutation_chamber.tooltip: Two caged parent bees (kept) turn a caged wild bee into a new species. No luck involved.
gtia.machine.nidavellir.tooltip.0: A disc of five concentric rings round the star of its system, built in five phases. Runs Alloy Blast Smelter and Ultimate Material Forge recipes in huge batches.
gtia.machine.nidavellir.tooltip.1: Each batch is pressed under neutronium dust: compression 0-4 gives 256 × 2^c parallels for 2^c dust.
gtia.machine.nidavellir.tooltip.2: Around a neutron star the magnetosphere presses four times as fast; from the pulsar vicinity, half the neutronium.
gtia.machine.qso.tooltip.0: A gun the size of a system round its quasar, built in five phases: the Final era.
gtia.machine.qso.tooltip.1: Charges a capacitor from the quasar and the Nexus network and fires it; each shot harvests negentropy.
gtia.machine.qso.tooltip.2: The world's negentropy is finite. With it spent, the last shot may end the game (a world rule).
gtia.machine.rocket_assembler.tooltip.fa: The Saturn V was stacked upright in a building 160 m tall, then rolled to the pad
gtia.machine.rocket_assembler.tooltip.ma: Builds Ad Astra rockets from their parts, GregTech components and Rocket Fuel
The tier 1 rocket takes HV power for 2 minutes
gtia.machine.rocket_assembler.tooltip.re: An Ad Astra Launch Pad (3 x 3) in the middle of the platform
Hatches go on the casings of the base and the control house in front
Overclocks like a GregTech machine and supports Batch Mode
gtia.machine.seed_analyzer.tooltip: Reveals the Growth, Gain and Resistance of Agronomica seeds.
gtia.machine.star_lifter.tooltip.0: Lifts matter off the star of the system it stands in, built in five phases.
gtia.machine.star_lifter.tooltip.1: Hydrogen and helium plasma, oxygen, neon, nitrogen and metal dusts; the star gets lighter, dimmer and longer-lived.
gtia.machine.star_lifter.tooltip.2: Power from the owner's Nexus network: the deeper the star's gravity well, the more it costs.
gtia.machine.stellar_engine.tooltip.0: Moves the Nexus System: a Shkadov mirror and a Caplan engine around its star, built in five phases. Works only there.
gtia.machine.stellar_engine.tooltip.1: The Δv it gathers takes the system to new regions of the galaxy, each with its own bonus (the Stellar era).
gtia.machine.stellar_engine.tooltip.2: The Caplan engine draws EU from the Nexus network and gives hydrogen and helium plasma.
gtia.machine.stellar_harvester.tooltip.0: Heats the core of its system's star until it burns its whole life in hours, built in five phases.
gtia.machine.stellar_harvester.tooltip.1: Pays the boosted starlight to the Nexus network: the budget is the core's hydrogen, 2^60 EU per solar mass.
gtia.machine.stellar_harvester.tooltip.2: When it runs out the star ends by its mass: white dwarf, neutron star or black hole.
gtia.machine.stellar_hoop.tooltip.0: A hoop that turns through the star's corona, built in five phases; works around the star of any star system.
gtia.machine.stellar_hoop.tooltip.1: Runs fusion, Electric Blast Furnace and Plasma Forge recipes with the corona's heat: up to 1024 in parallel, twice as fast, half the EU.
gtia.machine.stellar_hoop.tooltip.2: The lower it dives, the more parallel and the hotter the shields: feed it helium coolant.
gtia.machine.suprashell.tooltip.0: A shell world round the black hole of its system, built in five phases: only where the centre is a hole.
gtia.machine.suprashell.tooltip.1: Hosts GTCEu multiblock controllers put in its buses as modules and runs their recipes, 64 parallels each.
gtia.machine.suprashell.tooltip.2: Close to the hole the shell's clocks run slow, but lowering matter pays the EU: pick its radius.
gtia.machine.system_creator.tooltip.0: A stellar foundry, built in five phases: gathers a hydrogen cloud, collapses it and lights a new star in a new star system.
gtia.machine.system_creator.tooltip.1: Red dwarfs from phase 1; yellow with the rings, white with the Fusion Candle, blue giants with the Artificial Star Creator, neutron stars and black holes with the collapse lens.
gtia.machine.system_creator.tooltip.2: Costs hydrogen, iron dust and Ψ; every system made raises the Dimensional era. Its screen travels to the systems.
gtia.machine.yggdrasil.tooltip.0: A gas giant seeded with floating gardens inside a shell of hexagonal glass, built in five phases.
gtia.machine.yggdrasil.tooltip.1: Runs Greenhouse recipes, 256 parallels per phase; every harvest also gives 100 mB of biomass.
gtia.machine.yggdrasil.tooltip.2: Pick the gardens' depth: light fades as they sink, carbon dioxide rises. The best depth depends on the star.
gtia.matrioshka.needs_star: No star here: the Matrioshka Brain only works in the Nexus System.
gtia.matrioshka.psi: Ψ of the owner: %s thought cycles
gtia.matrioshka.ui.fracture_warning: %s shell(s) fractured: put their blocks in an input bus
gtia.matrioshka.ui.limit_hint: Limit now: %s K (the main rings of phase 4 add 40 K).
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.0: The Matrioshka Brain wraps the Nexus star in shells of computers. Each finished phase is one shell, computing with the starlight that reaches it.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.10: Temperatures move slowly (10 s time constant): a short clock peak can be held before the shells heat up.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.11: = T > 500 K (540 K with phase 4) → overheated: no CWU, -2% integrity a second
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.12: An overheated shell computes nothing and wears; the outer field of phase 5 halves the wear. At 0% the shell fractures and stays off.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.13: Repair: put the shell's own blocks in an input bus on the station. Each block gives back 5%, one per shell a second, while it is not overheated.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.14: = Ψ/s = (max CWU/t × 20 - CWU used in the second) / 2^20
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.15: CWU nobody asks for becomes Ψ (thought cycles), kept for the owner like the Nexus network's EU.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.16: Send CWU through up to 2 Optical Data Transmission Hatches on the station; coolant and repair blocks enter through fluid hatches and input buses there too.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.17: The brain only works in the Nexus System, around its star.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.18: Phases 2 to 5 can come later: a phase counts once all its blocks and those of the phases before it are in place.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.19: While it runs, every ring but the polar one leaves the world and turns; switching off puts them back.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.2: A shell at radius r sits in the star's light. Radiating more power (a higher clock) needs a hotter shell.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.3: = CWU/t of shell n = 2^(21+n) × clock × 300 K / T
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.4: Landauer's limit: erasing a bit costs k·T·ln 2, so a colder shell computes more with the same energy. The cold outer shells give the most.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.6: A coolant pulls the shells towards its own temperature Tc. The best one in the fluid hatches is used:
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.7: = He 4 K, η 0.40, 250 mB/s · He-II 2 K, η 0.60, 100 mB/s · DSS 0.1 K, η 0.85, 10 mB/s (per phase, × clock)
gtia.matrioshka.ui.manual.8: Superfluid helium comes from liquid helium in a Vacuum Freezer; the Dimensionally Shifted Superfluid from the Forge of the Gods' chain.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.no_star: No star here: build it in the Nexus System.
gtia.matrioshka.ui.overheat_warning: %s shell(s) overheated: lower the clock or add coolant
gtia.matrioshka.ui.shells_hint: Unbuilt shells show what they would give at this clock and coolant.
gtia.nidavellir.ui.idle.neutronium: Waiting: not enough neutronium dust for a batch
gtia.nidavellir.ui.idle.no_recipe: Waiting: no alloy recipe matches the buses
gtia.nidavellir.ui.idle.power: Waiting: not enough EU in the Nexus network
gtia.nidavellir.ui.manual.1: Neutron-star matter is packed to ~4 × 10¹⁷ kg/m³: a thin layer of neutronium dust under the hammers presses a whole batch at once.
gtia.nidavellir.ui.manual.10: =neutronium per batch = max(1, 2^c / 2) after the pulsar vicinity
gtia.nidavellir.ui.manual.11: Without enough dust for one batch the forge waits; it never runs a batch it cannot press.
gtia.nidavellir.ui.manual.2: =parallel = 256 × 2^c;  neutronium per batch = 2^c  (compression c from 0 to 4)
gtia.nidavellir.ui.manual.3: Each built phase opens one more step of compression (c ≤ phases - 1). EU is paid from the Nexus network as in the base recipe.
gtia.nidavellir.ui.manual.5: A neutron star's field reaches 10⁸–10¹¹ T. The superconducting ring (phase 2) rides it, and the press strikes four times as often.
gtia.nidavellir.ui.manual.7: Make one with the Interstellar System Creator, or let the Fusion Suppressor collapse a star of 8-20 M☉.
gtia.nidavellir.ui.manual.9: Once the Stellar Engine has carried the network to the pulsar vicinity, the press arm (phase 3) pulls fresh neutronium from its wind.
gtia.nidavellir.ui.manual.tip: How the forge works, with its formulas.
gtia.organ.planet_warning: This planet tears at your body: it needs an organ set of tier %s
gtia.organ.tooltip.set_header: A full set of this tier gives:
gtia.organ.tooltip.speed: Both legs at this tier: +%s%% movement speed
gtia.organ.tooltip.wing: Gives flight while it lasts; wings are used one after the other
gtia.organ_modifier.tooltip.2: Each organ set gives different effects
gtia.organ_modifier.tooltip.4: Planets need an organ set of a certain tier
gtia.qso.final_broadcast: The Quasi-Stellar Obliterator fires its last shot. The universe has no order left to give. The game is over.
gtia.qso.ui.manual.1: A quasar is a black hole swallowing matter at its Eddington limit, the brightest steady light there is.
gtia.qso.ui.manual.10: When it is spent and the world rule allows it, the next shot is the last: the Final era closes and the game ends.
gtia.qso.ui.manual.11: Modpacks set the stock and may turn the ending off; the negentropy is kept for their own final recipes.
gtia.qso.ui.manual.2: =input = 2^40 EU/t x M/M☉ x 20 + 2^42 EU/s x draw (0-16)
gtia.qso.ui.manual.3: =charge = charge x 0.99 + input each second;  ceiling = input / 0.01
gtia.qso.ui.manual.5: A shot of size k holds 2^50 x 2^(k+1) EU; aiming costs 2^50 of it. Sizes up to 2 + phases, at most 7.
gtia.qso.ui.manual.7: Big shots waste less on aiming but fill slowly and leak; past the ceiling they never fire. A heavier hole lifts it.
gtia.qso.ui.manual.9: Ordered energy fired at the 2.7 K sky is negentropy; the world holds only so much (a world rule), shared by all.
gtia.qso.ui.manual.tip: How the gun works, with its formulas.
gtia.rule.chemistry.catalyst_wear.desc: Chance per run, in hundredths of a percent, that the catalyst of a GTIA chemistry plant wears out. 0 keeps every catalyst forever.
gtia.rule.chemistry.heat_recovery.desc: Multiplies the steam the chemistry plants make from their own reaction heat.
gtia.rule.machines.clean_multiblocks.des: Multiblocks run cleanroom recipes without a cleanroom.
gtia.rule.machines.explosions_damage_ter: Machine explosions destroy the blocks around them.
gtia.rule.machines.final_ending: The last shot ends the game
gtia.rule.machines.final_ending.desc: When the world's negentropy is spent, the Obliterator's next shot ends the game.
gtia.rule.machines.harmless_active_trans: Active transformers don't hurt nearby players.
gtia.rule.machines.maintenance.desc: Multiblocks need a maintenance hatch and develop problems over time.
gtia.rule.machines.miner_speed.desc: Multiplies the speed of the single-block GregTech miners.
gtia.rule.machines.negentropy_stock.desc: Units of negentropy the Final era can harvest in this world, all players together.
gtia.rule.machines.ordered_assembly_flui: The assembly line needs its fluids in recipe order.
gtia.rule.machines.ordered_assembly_item: The assembly line needs its items in recipe order.
gtia.rule.machines.require_gt_tools.desc: GregTech machines and pipes only drop when broken with a GregTech tool.
gtia.rule.machines.weather_explosions.de: Machines left in the rain or in bad spots can explode.
gtia.rule.organs.organ_cost.desc: Multiplies the parts of every organ recipe.
gtia.rule.organs.planet_requirement.desc: Other planets hurt players whose organ set tier is too low: the Moon and Mars need tier 1.
gtia.rule.power.fuel_efficiency.desc: Multiplies how long each fuel lasts in generators and boilers. Higher is better.
gtia.rule.recipes.casings_per_craft.desc: How many machine casings one crafting recipe makes.
gtia.rule.recipes.duration_multiplier.de: Multiplies the time of every GregTech machine recipe. Lower is faster.
gtia.rule.recipes.eu_multiplier.desc: Multiplies the energy per tick of every GregTech machine recipe. A recipe never moves to another voltage tier.
The flint and steel needs a steel part.
gtia.rule.recipes.hard_advanced_iron.des: Iron doors, trapdoors, anvils and similar need iron plates and rods.
gtia.rule.recipes.hard_dyes.desc: Coloring blocks such as concrete or glass is harder.
gtia.rule.recipes.hard_glass.desc: Glass and glass items get harder recipes.
gtia.rule.recipes.hard_iron.desc: Iron items (buckets, hoppers, cauldrons…) need plates.
gtia.rule.recipes.hard_misc.desc: Other vanilla items get GregTech recipes.
gtia.rule.recipes.hard_tools_armor.desc: Vanilla tools and armor need plates and GregTech tools.
gtia.rule.recipes.hard_wood.desc: Wooden items (doors, chests, signs…) need GregTech parts.
gtia.rule.recipes.harder_bricks.desc: Harder crafting recipes for bricks, firebricks, nether bricks and coke oven bricks.
gtia.rule.recipes.harder_charcoal.desc: Charcoal can't be smelted from logs in a furnace.
gtia.rule.recipes.harder_circuits.desc: The first circuit of each set makes 1 instead of 2, and SoC recipes make 2 instead of 4.
gtia.rule.recipes.harder_rods.desc: The lathe makes 1 rod and 2 small piles of dust instead of 2 rods.
gtia.rule.recipes.manual_compression.des: Ingots can be packed into blocks (and blocks back into ingots) in the crafting table.
gtia.rule.recipes.nerf_paper.desc: Paper gets a harder crafting recipe.
gtia.rule.recipes.nerf_wood.desc: A log makes 2 planks and 2 planks make 2 sticks.
Removes the crafting table recipes of vanilla blocks; GregTech machines make them.
gtia.rule.recipes.remove_vanilla_tnt.des: TNT is made by GregTech machines only.
gtia.rule.resources.infinite_bedrock_flu: Bedrock fluid veins never run dry.
gtia.rule.resources.ore_vein_grid.desc: One vein per grid cell of this size; smaller means more veins. Only new chunks change.
gtia.rule.resources.rubber_tree_chance.d: Multiplies how often rubber trees grow in new chunks.
Multiplies the time of each GTNA Electric Void Miner operation.
gtia.rule.steam.boiler_output.desc: Multiplies the steam made by the small GregTech boilers.
gtia.rule.steam.duration_multiplier_stea: Multiplies the recipe time of the GTNA steam multiblocks, on top of the recipe duration rule.
gtia.rule.steam.large_boiler_steam.desc: Multiplies the steam the large boilers make from each unit of water.
gtia.rule.steam.parallel_multiplier.desc: Multiplies how many recipes the GTNA steam multiblocks run at once.
gtia.rule.steam.wireless_steam.desc: The GTNA wireless steam hatches can be crafted. Off: steam goes through pipes.
gtia.rule.survival.extra_regen_food.desc: Food level from which you heal faster. 21 turns it off.
gtia.rule.survival.keep_inventory.desc: Players keep their items on death. Set when the world is created; /gamerule can change it.
gtia.rule.survival.material_hazards.desc: Radioactive and toxic materials hurt players who carry them without protection.
gtia.rule.survival.ultimine_limit.desc: Most blocks FTB Ultimine breaks at once.
gtia.rule.tools.electric_tool_damage_cha: Chance in percent that an electric tool loses durability on use.
gtia.rule.tools.electric_tool_energy.des: Multiplies the energy electric tools use.
gtia.rule.tools.enchanted_tools.desc: GregTech tools come with their material's enchantments.
gtia.rule.tools.prospector_energy.desc: Multiplies the energy the prospector uses.
gtia.rules.command.no_world: Join a world to see its GTIA Rules.
gtia.rules.preset.custom.desc: Starts from the selected preset; edit every value below.
gtia.rules.preset.journey.desc: A gentler pace: faster and cheaper recipes, stronger steam, no maintenance and simpler vanilla recipes.
gtia.rules.restart.existing_world: This world (%s) uses other values for rules that GregTech reads only when the game starts:
gtia.rules.restart.existing_world.after: Save and Quit stores them and closes the game; open the world after starting it again. Playing now runs the world with this session's values for these rules.
gtia.rules.restart.new_world: %s changes rules that GregTech reads only when the game starts:
gtia.rules.restart.new_world.after: Save and Quit stores them and closes the game. Start it again and create the world: your choice is kept, and this world and your other worlds never mix values.
gtia.rules.restart.title: Restart needed
gtia.rules.screen.button.tooltip: Difficulty preset of this world: Journey, Normal or Custom. It can't be changed after the world is created.
gtia.rules.screen.locked: A world's rules are fixed when it is created.
gtia.rules.screen.restart_needed: ⚠ These rules need a game restart: Create World will save and quit first
gtia.rules.screen.title: GTIA Rules
gtia.rules.warning.file_mismatch: gtia_rules.json was edited, but a world's rules can't change. This world stays %s.
gtia.rules.warning.missing: This world had lost its GTIA rules, so it was set to %s. Back up your saves before moving them around.
gtia.rules.warning.restart: This world (%s) uses rules that GTCEu reads when the game starts. They were saved for the next start: restart the game to apply them.
gtia.star_lifter.needs_star: No star here: the Star Lifter works around the star of a star system.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.girdle_broken: The sphere is broken: repair it with its blocks.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.1: Matter on the star's surface is held by gravity. The lifter heats it and pinches the star's field so it leaves through the poles, where the collector rings catch it.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.11: One second of play is a million years of lifting, so the star really gets lighter.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.12: =ΔM = ṁ × 3.16e13 s per second;  L = M^4;  T = 5772 (L / R²)^¼
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.14: A lighter star is dimmer: the Matrioshka Brain gets (L / L☉)^¾ of its computation, the Stellar Engine pushes a lighter star faster. Below 0.5 M☉ the ring cannot hold the outflow.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.16: The stirring rings (phase 5) stir the core: helium and metals come up and fresh hydrogen goes down, adding to the fuel.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.18: Above 60% the star grows restless: at 100% instability a flare costs the sphere 25%.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.19: Repair: idle, put sphere and spoke blocks in an input bus (+5% each).
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.2: =e = G M / R  (1.9e11 J/kg for the Sun)
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.4: Thermal wind (phase 1) lifts up to 1e11 kg/s; the ring current (phase 2) up to 1e12 kg/s.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.6: The collector rings (phase 3) catch 85% of the outflow; without them only 15% is caught.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.8: Only hydrogen and helium plasma come out until the spires (phase 4) sort oxygen, neon, nitrogen and metal dusts.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.manual.9: Beyond the Orion arm's edge (Stellar Engine) the star's wind is 25% richer.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.no_spires: Phase 4 sorts metals and gases out of the plasma.
gtia.star_lifter.ui.s.title: The star
gtia.stellar_engine.needs_star: No star here: the Stellar Engine only works in the Nexus System.
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.cage_broken: Cage broken: put rib blocks in an input bus
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.0: The Stellar Engine moves the whole Nexus System. A Shkadov mirror and a Caplan engine work together around its star.
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.1: = F(Shkadov) = f × L / c, f = 0.25 (a 60° cap of mirror)
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.10: One second of play is a million years of engine. The Δv gathered is kept for the owner and never goes back.
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.11: = Power = 2^36 EU/t from the Nexus network
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.12: Without power only the mirror pushes. The engine also gives hydrogen and helium plasma to the output hatches.
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.13: Regions: Orion edge 20 km/s (+25% matter), interarm void 60 (colder Matrioshka shells), emission nebula 120 (more hydrogen), pulsar vicinity 250 (neutronium), galactic core 500.
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.14: The galaxy map shows the route, the regions reached and where the system is now.
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.15: Phases: 1 cage and station, 2 mirror, 3 collector ring, 4 Caplan engine, 5 nozzle and counter-jet guides.
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.2: The mirror sends part of the starlight back: the light leaves only on one side and the system moves (Shkadov, 1987).
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.3: = F(Caplan) = β × ṁ × v_e, v_e = 0.01 c, ṁ = 10^12 kg/s
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.4: The Caplan engine lifts hydrogen and helium from the star with magnetic fields, fuses the helium and fires two jets (Caplan, 2019).
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.5: β is the share of the lifted mass in the main jet; the rest goes back into the star so it follows the engine.
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.6: = Tension = (β - 70%) / 20%, at least 50% without the guides of phase 5
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.7: Above 70% the counter-jet cannot hold the star and the cage strains: -2% integrity a second at full tension.
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.8: Repair the cage with rib and hoop blocks in an input bus on the station, +5% a block, while there is no tension.
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.manual.9: = Δv per second = F / M_sun × 10^6 years
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.no_power: Caplan engine without EU: only the mirror pushes
gtia.stellar_engine.ui.no_star: No star here: build it in the Nexus System.
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.heat.tip: Core heating: left click +0.05, right click -0.05.
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.manual.1: Fusion speeds up steeply with core temperature: as T^4 in the proton-proton chain of light stars, T^16 in the CNO cycle of stars above 1.3 M☉.
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.manual.10: A neutron star feeds the Nidavellir, a black hole the HRAE-MC. Make a star for the purpose with the System Creator.
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.manual.11: The countdown shows the time left at the present heat; it cannot be undone once the core is gone.
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.manual.2: =boost = (1 + h)^n,  n = 4 or 16;  h up to 0.3 x phases
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.manual.3: =power = 2^30 EU/t x L/L☉ x boost  (boost at most a million)
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.manual.5: Only the core hydrogen burns: 0.7% of the mass of a tenth of the star turns into light.
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.manual.6: =budget = 2^60 EU x M/M☉ x fuel left
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.manual.7: Heating harder burns the same budget faster: the total never grows. Heavy stars hold more and burn far faster.
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.manual.9: When the core is spent the star ends by its mass: below 8 M☉ a white dwarf, to 20 M☉ a neutron star, above a black hole.
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.manual.tip: How the harvest works, with its formulas.
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.spent.1: Spent: the star is a white dwarf
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.spent.2: Spent: the core collapsed to a neutron star
gtia.stellar_harvester.ui.spent.3: Spent: the core collapsed to a black hole
gtia.stellar_hoop.needs_star: No star here: the Stellar Hoop works around the star of a star system.
gtia.stellar_hoop.ui.manual.1: An eccentric hoop turns about its own centre; once a turn each segment passes the dive point, just above the photosphere, and its crucibles take in the corona's plasma.
gtia.stellar_hoop.ui.manual.11: Each mB of liquid helium takes 1 unit of load, Helium II 3, shifted superfluid 10; the best one in the hatches is used.
gtia.stellar_hoop.ui.manual.13: At 0% the hoop stops. Idle, it takes shield and hull blocks from an input bus: +5% each.
gtia.stellar_hoop.ui.manual.14: The second hoop (phase 5) runs higher and doubles the crucibles.
gtia.stellar_hoop.ui.manual.3: Recipes up to that heat run: fusion, Electric Blast Furnace and Plasma Forge.
gtia.stellar_hoop.ui.manual.6: The corona thins out with height (scale height ~7% R): lower plasma is denser, so more of it comes in at once.
gtia.stellar_hoop.ui.manual.9: The load rises faster than the parallel: a high dive is cheaper per craft, a low one faster.
gtia.suprashell.ui.idle.no_recipe: Waiting: no hosted recipe matches the buses
gtia.suprashell.ui.idle.power: Waiting: not enough EU in the Nexus network
gtia.suprashell.ui.manual.1: Put GTCEu multiblock controllers in the input buses: each is a module; the shell runs the recipes of all their kinds.
gtia.suprashell.ui.manual.11: Close: cheap and slow, few modules. Far: full price, fast, room for hundreds.
gtia.suprashell.ui.manual.2: =parallel = 64 x modules hosted  (up to the room)
gtia.suprashell.ui.manual.3: =room = r^2 modules (r in rs), at most 64 x phases
gtia.suprashell.ui.manual.5: A static shell near a black hole sits deep in its well: its clocks run slow, seen from outside.
gtia.suprashell.ui.manual.7: At 1.5 rs the shell works at 58%; at 20 rs, at 97%.
gtia.suprashell.ui.manual.9: Matter lowered on a rope from far away down to the shell gives up 1 - tau of its rest energy (Geroch's process).
gtia.suprashell.ui.manual.tip: How the shell works, with its formulas.
gtia.system_creator.ui.cancel.tip: Let the cloud disperse: what was gathered and the Ψ are lost.
gtia.system_creator.ui.forge.tip: Start a star: takes the Ψ and the iron dust now, then gathers hydrogen from the hatches.
gtia.system_creator.ui.kind.tip: Click to pick the next star kind (the chart shows heat to the left, light upwards).
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.1: Stars form when a cold cloud collapses under its own gravity. The Creator gathers the cloud, squeezes it with its rings and lights the core with the Fusion Candle.
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.10: =E = 2^41 EU × M² / R  (binding energy ∝ (3/5) G M²/R)
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.12: Phase 1 red dwarf (0.3 M☉), 2 yellow dwarf (1), 3 white star (2), 4 blue giant (15), 5 neutron star (from 15 M☉ of gas) and black hole (from 25).
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.13: Remnants need four times the Ψ: the collapse is computed through the lens.
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.14: Metallicity Z (½, 1, 2, 3 × the Sun) sets how rich the new system is when mined or taken apart.
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.16: Each new star becomes a system of its own (six slots). The orrery picks one; Travel takes you to its landing platform.
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.17: =Dimensional era: I at 1 system, II at 3, III at 6
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.18: Stars that are burnt, suppressed or taken apart (Harvester, Fusion Suppressor, Disintegrator) are meant for these systems.
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.19: Dispersing a cloud loses what was gathered and the Ψ spent.
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.3: =Ψ = 2^20 × M × Z;  iron dust = 16 × M × Z
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.4: Gathering takes up to 50 000 mB a second from the hatches.
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.6: The cloud falls in on itself in its free-fall time; a disk forms round the protostar and two jets leave its poles.
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.7: =t_ff = √(3π / 32 G ρ) ∝ √(R³/M):  60 s for a Sun, 20 to 300 s
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.9: The Fusion Candle (phase 3) pays the cloud's binding energy over 20 s; without it only a red dwarf lights, slowly and without EU.
gtia.system_creator.ui.manual.tip: How stars are made here, with the formulas.
gtia.system_creator.ui.metal.tip: Metallicity of the new system: richer systems give more when mined or taken apart, and cost more Ψ and iron.
gtia.system_creator.ui.msg.no_slot: No free system: take one apart
gtia.system_creator.ui.msg.phase: That star needs a later phase
gtia.system_creator.ui.travel.tip: Go to the selected system, onto a landing platform.
gtia.vein_card.blank: Right-click inside a bedrock vein to record it
gtia.vein_card.none: No bedrock vein under this chunk
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.idle.no_recipe: Waiting: no greenhouse recipe matches the buses
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.idle.power: Waiting: not enough EU in the Nexus network
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.manual.1: Plants buoyed in the gas giant's atmosphere grow from seeds kept in the input bus, like a Greenhouse, by the hundred.
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.manual.10: =z* = 0.5 ln(L / 0.015)  (Sun: 2.1; blue giant: the bottom; red dwarf: the top)
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.manual.11: The chart shows the curve for this star: the gold line is your depth, the dashed one the best.
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.manual.2: =parallel = 256 x phases;  biomass = 100 mB per harvest
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.manual.3: Recipes: the Greenhouse. EU comes from the Nexus network, as in the base recipe.
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.manual.5: Sunlight fades as the gardens sink (Beer-Lambert), while the pressure and the carbon dioxide grow (barometric).
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.manual.6: =I = L e^-z;  c = 0.05 e^z;  growth = I/(I + 0.3) x c/(c + 1)
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.manual.7: Depth z is in scale heights, 0 to 8; L is the star's luminosity in suns. Rate = 10 x growth, from x0.05 to x6.
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.manual.9: Growth peaks where light and carbon limit it equally: deeper round a bright star, near the top round a dim one.
gtia.yggdrasil.ui.manual.tip: How the gardens grow, with the formulas.
gtna.ui.o.eng_beta_down.tip: Send less of the lifted mass out as the main jet (less thrust, less tension).
gtna.ui.o.eng_beta_up.tip: Send more of the lifted mass out as the main jet (more thrust; above 70% the cage strains).
gtna.ui.o.eng_caplan.tip: Switch the Caplan engine (EU from the Nexus network); without it only the mirror pushes.
gtna.ui.o.eng_manual.tip: How the engine works, with its formulas.
gtna.ui.o.eng_map.tip: Map of the galaxy: the route, the regions and where the system is.
gtna.ui.o.mb_clock_down.tip: Lower the clock by 25% (less CWU, cooler shells).
gtna.ui.o.mb_clock_up.tip: Raise the clock by 25% (more CWU, hotter shells).
gtna.ui.o.mb_manual.tip: How the brain works, with its formulas.
gtna.ui.o.mb_shells.tip: Table of the five shells: radius, temperature, CWU, state.
gtna.ui.o.nd_press.down: Ease off: fewer parallels, less neutronium a batch.
gtna.ui.o.nd_press.up: Press harder: more parallels, more neutronium a batch.
gtna.ui.o.sh_lever.down: Dive: pull plasma from 2% lower (denser and hotter: more parallel, more shield load).
gtna.ui.o.sh_lever.up: Rise: pull plasma from 2% higher (thinner, cooler, cheaper per craft).
gtna.ui.o.sh_manual.tip: How the hoop works, with its formulas.
gtna.ui.o.sl_manual.tip: How star lifting works, with its formulas.
gtna.ui.o.sl_mode.tip: Thermal wind (phase 1), ring current (phase 2) or deep stirring (phase 5).
gtna.ui.o.sl_rate.up: Lift 10% more (more matter, more power, the star shrinks faster).
gtna.ui.o.sl_star.tip: Mass, light, temperature and the life the star has left.
